en: Deuteronomy 30

p.src: 1  It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

ja: に置いたこれらのすべての事、すなわち
en: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,
u.src: 1  It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

p.src: 2  and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

ja: あなたがあなたの神、主に立ち返り、あなたもあなたの
en: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
u.src: 2  and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

p.src: 3  that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.

ja: らわれの身から解放し、あなたをあわれみ、あなたの
en: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.
u.src: 3  that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.

p.src: 4  If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

ja: てにいたとしても、そこからあなたの
en: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.
u.src: 4  If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

p.src: 5  The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

ja: はあなたに良いことを行い、あなたを父
en: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.
u.src: 5  The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

p.src: 6  The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

ja: するようにされる。それはあなたが生きるためである。
en: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
u.src: 6  The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

p.src: 7  The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

en: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
u.src: 7  The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

p.src: 8  You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

en: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
u.src: 8  You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

p.src: 9  The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers, 10  if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

ja: あなたの神、主は、あなたの手のすべての働き、あなたの胎の実、あなたの家畜の産物、そしてあなたの地の産物において、あなたを豊かにして幸いを与えられる。主があなたの父祖たちを喜ばれたように、主は再びあなたを喜んで幸いを与えられるからである。
それはあなたが、あなたの
されている主の命令と掟を
zh: 你若聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，謹守這律法書上所寫的誡命律例，又盡心盡性歸向耶和華－你的上帝，他必使你手裏所辦的一切事，並你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所產的，都綽綽有餘；因為耶和華必再喜悅你，降福與你，像從前喜悅你列祖一樣。
en: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
u.src: 9  The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers, 10  if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

p.src: 11  For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

ja: じるこの命令は、あなたにとって
しすぎるものではなく、
en: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.
u.src: 11  For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

p.src: 12  It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

ja: にあるのではない。だから、『だれが
り、それを私たちのもとに持って
たちがそれを行えるように
かせてくれるだろうか』と
en: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
u.src: 12  It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

p.src: 13  Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

ja: こうにあるのでもない。だから、『だれが
り、それを私たちのもとに持って
たちがそれを行えるように
かせてくれるだろうか』と
en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
u.src: 13  Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

p.src: 14  But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

ja: にある。あなたがそれを
en: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
u.src: 14  But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

p.src: 15  Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

ja: に命と繁栄、そして死と災いを
en: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
u.src: 15  Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

p.src: 16  For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

ja: え広がり、あなたが所有するために入って行くその地で、あなたの
en: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.
u.src: 16  For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

p.src: 17  But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

en: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,
u.src: 17  But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

p.src: 18  I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

ja: 今日わたしはあなたがたに宣言する。あなたがたは
びる。あなたが所有するためにヨルダン
en: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
u.src: 18  I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

p.src: 19  I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

ja: に呼ぶ。わたしはあなたの前に
びなさい。あなたもあなたの
en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,
u.src: 19  I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

p.src: 20  to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

ja: さだからである。それは、
たち、アブラハム、イサク、ヤコブに
en: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
u.src: 20  to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
